{{Top|leg}}
'''Comm node CALIPSA989.9128/P''' was a communications channel in use by [[House Calipsa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nils Wender]] requested that [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] seeking work aboard the ''[[Bright Seeker]]'', a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] commissioned to find a new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] out of [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], to contact him using the node.<ref name="LD">{{WEGCite|story=Lost Destiny|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
